summary: Iteration 218 - i18n system testing for 7 languages (FR, EN, DE, ES, IT, PT, NL). Language selector and switching work correctly on onboarding. Login successful. Dashboard shows mixed translations - some sections translated to English, others remain in French. Medical translations file (medicalTranslations.ts) properly integrated with I18nContext.
